# NetSuite CPQ Configurator

NetSuite CPQ Configurator (152 pages): NetSuite CPQ Configurator

## Chapters
- [NetSuite CPQ Configurator](article_7121343557.md): Your account lets you create all kinds of items, such as inventory items, non-inventory items, and assemblies.
  - [Updated Labels for User Interface Elements](article_1193859108.md): NetSuite CPQ Configurator includes updated labels for some elements you see on the user interface.
  - [NetSuite CPQ Configurator Setup](article_9124208079.md): After installing NetSuite CPQ Configurator, define basic settings on the options record at CPQ Configurator Settings.
  - [NetSuite CPQ Configurator Products](article_6124716984.md): NetSuite CPQ Configurator uses products to represent configurable items.
  - [Working with Product Building Blocks](subsect_0926032123.md): Products are organized into building blocks, such as questions, answers, and images.
  - [Configuring Items From Transactions](article_5085131325.md): Users can access configurable items from eligible transactions.
